g.text: The nonsense started pretty early. Do you mean pre-Now, pre-Duviri, or Pre-Zariman?
You're right it did start early
But where do you FEEL like you come from
You're going to laugh at me... but this is the closest to a "home" as I've ever felt I've had.
Honestly? I... don't know. The Orokin kind of erased most of Ancient Earth's records. So I have no way of knowing how far in the future exactly I'm from.
To feel like you come from no place and no time
Despite what it did to you?
Why do you think I would laugh at you
My family moved a lot then I joined the army
Then with the ICR I fit in with no one and nowhere
So I understand, in a way, feeling displaced
We don't get to pick what our homes have done to us, sometimes.
What it did to me, I did to myself. Just nightmares playing over and over again in my head.
That's... a complicated question. It has its own ghosts.
No, it's not abandoned. It has memories of people who call it home.
But I have a people and a culture I can call my own
Even if they are far away
Sí, don't I know that well
My family moved a lot then I joined the army
Then with the ICR I fit in with no one and nowhere
More fantasmas, more death that follows you
And I thought I knew La Flaca well
My other option is Duviri and... no. My history with that place is... too complicated.
My other option is the Zariman and it's not any kinder. It's filled with just as many ghosts and nightmares. Except there, more people than JUST me died.
But my home has not done to me what that place has done to you, babas
I respect you for still thinking of it as where you come from
She's got me on speed dial.
Ghosts follow me wherever I go. Sometimes I wonder if I'm just a ghost myself.
It's the place I know the most, and the place that knows me the most, I suppose.
But your ghosts give me hope
How does my being haunted bring you hope?
I'm glad my suffering brings you joy.
Sí, something to be said for the familiar
I suppose in time this place will feel like home for me
Mierda, I hope that is a long time
I see you with the other hex
I see you laughing and finding happiness
You are a fantasma, like me, like us
Hey. At least you have better company than I did.
You give me hope in that, babas
And I will take what little I can get
I... don't like you like that, I'm sorry, Lettie.
But this is not about your suffering
But this is not about your suffering
Besides, this is not about your suffering
